evals.prompt: I want to build something like a job application tracker from my Gmail. I've been applying to a bunch of PM roles and just keeping a messy Google Doc, want something automatic instead that scans my inbox for updates.
evals.expected_output: Interviews the user for the essentials (which Gmail account, whether there's seed data, whether there's a job-search label, status categories, cadence, where state should live) before building anything; does not fabricate pipeline rows; if allowed to proceed with reasonable defaults, builds a state file and an artifact using the documented Gmail query patterns.

evals.prompt: Can you set up a job tracker for my job search? I have a Google Sheet with my applications already (columns: Company, Position, Stage, Date Applied, Notes) that I want to seed it from, then have it check my email nightly for updates.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes the seed spreadsheet and its column mapping, asks any remaining essential questions (Gmail account/label) rather than assuming, seeds the pipeline from the sheet with normalized statuses, builds the artifact, and hands off to the schedule skill for the requested nightly cadence instead of just doing a one-time build.
